'''Cerdana''' was the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the [[Altiri/Legends|Altiri]] [[Species/Legends|species]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Altiria/Anarris]]. Cerdana, considered the pinnacle of Altiri society and culture, was strategically located along the shores of the planet's longest [[River (disambiguation)|river]]. Cerdana was considered by some to be strikingly beautiful. Altiri believed that each structure should reflect the designer's personality and function as both a building and a work of art. As a result, many different architectural styles came together to create a cityscape that was a perpetually developing example of Altirian culture.<ref name="TUR" />

Cerdana had a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] and was the seat of the democratic government of the Altiri.<ref name="TUR" />
